title_en: Chongqing Municipal People's Procuratorate v. Chen Xin — embezzlement and misappropriation of public funds
ruling_gist_en: A staff member of a state-owned bank who, by taking advantage of his position, misappropriates public funds, absconds with the company's bank account certificates and all stock trading documents, thereby placing the public funds under his own control, and who has the ability to repay but refuses to do so, with the subjective intent of unlawful possession, shall be convicted of the crime of embezzlement.

full_text_en:
Procuratorate of Chongqing Municipality v. Chen Xin — embezzlement and misappropriation of public funds

(This case was decided upon deliberation at the 1257th meeting of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court)

[Ruling Summary]

A state-owned bank employee who, by taking advantage of his position, misappropriates public funds, absconds with the company's bank account vouchers and all stock trading procedures, places the misappropriated funds under his own control, and refuses to return them despite having the ability to do so, has the subjective intent of illegal possession, and his conduct constitutes the crime of embezzlement.

Criminal Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

(2002) Xing Fu Zi No. 19

Defendant: Chen Xin, male, born September 13, 1965, Han ethnicity, native of Kaiyuan City, Yunnan Province, education level: junior college, former accountant at the Yangjiaping Sub-Branch of the Jiulongpo Sub-Branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Chongqing, residing at No. 5, Building 5, Block 4, Xiejiawan Cultural Village, Jiulongpo District, Chongqing. Arrested on March 12, 2001. Currently in custody.

The First Intermediate People's Court of Chongqing Municipality, having heard the case initiated by the First Branch of the Chongqing Municipal People's Procuratorate charging the defendant Chen Xin with the crimes of embezzlement and misappropriation of public funds, rendered criminal judgment (2001) Yu Yi Zhong Xing Chu Zi No. 363 on September 6, 2001, finding the defendant Chen Xin guilty of embezzlement, sentencing him to death, with deprivation of political rights for life and confiscation of all personal property; guilty of misappropriation of public funds, sentencing him to fixed-term imprisonment of ten years; and deciding the combined sentence of death, with deprivation of political rights for life and confiscation of all personal property. After the judgment was pronounced, Chen Xin appealed. The Chongqing High People's Court, by criminal ruling (2001) Yu Gao Fa Xing Zhong Zi No. 432 on December 30, 2001, rejected the appeal, affirmed the original judgment, and reported the case to this Court for approval in accordance with the law. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and conducted a review of the case. After deliberation at the 1257th meeting of the Judicial Committee, the review has now been concluded.

Upon review, it is established that:

From May 22 to July 17, 1995, the defendant Chen Xin, taking advantage of his position as the bill exchange accountant at the Yangjiaping Sub-Branch of the Jiulongpo Sub-Branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (hereinafter referred to as the Yangjiaping Sub-Branch), with the authority to directly handle various incoming and outgoing customer bills and manage the funds in Account 284, by means of withholding customer credit advices and substituting them with self-made false credit advices, on 16 occasions misappropriated customer funds totaling over RMB 1,000,000 into an account of Chongqing Xinyuan Materials Company (hereinafter referred to as Xinyuan Company) under his control. Of this amount, RMB 997,000 was transferred into an account opened by him at the Chongqing Business Department of Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Company for stock trading to make profits. In July of the same year, Chen Xin twice transferred a total of over RMB 1,000,000 from his stock account to repay the misappropriated public funds.

From April 1996 to April 2000, the defendant Chen Xin, taking advantage of his position and using the same methods, on separate occasions misappropriated customer funds totaling over RMB 7,430,000 from Account 284 into the Xinyuan Company account, and then transferred them respectively into stock fund accounts opened by him at the Milky Way Securities Company, the Daping Business Department of Everbright Securities Company, and the Yangjiaping Business Department of Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Company for stock trading to make profits. From June 1996 to December 1998, Chen Xin on four occasions transferred a total of over RMB 2,680,000 from his stock accounts to repay part of the misappropriated funds, leaving over RMB 4,750,000 that could not be repaid.

On May 8 and May 10, 2000, the defendant Chen Xin, taking advantage of his position in managing Account 921, which handled the reporting of settlement funds for the Jiulongpo Sub-Branch of the ICBC, falsely increased the reported settlement funds in the Yangjiaping Sub-Branch's books by over RMB 4,750,000, thereby filling the shortfall of over RMB 4,750,000 in Account 284.

On May 25 and May 30, 2000, the defendant Chen Xin, taking advantage of his position, on two occasions falsely added to the normal settlement reports in Account 921 an increase of RMB 20,000,000 in the reported settlement funds of the Yangjiaping Sub-Branch, and then prepared false credit advices, on three occasions transferring the RMB 20,000,000 into the stock fund account opened by him at the Yangjiaping Business Department of Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Company (hereinafter referred to as the Shenyin Wanguo stock account) for stock trading to make profits.

From June 1 to September 19, 2000, the defendant Chen Xin, taking advantage of his position and using the same methods, on four occasions falsely increased the reported settlement funds in Account 921 by over RMB 15,240,000, which were transferred into the account of Chongqing Yongwei Commercial Company at the Yangjiaping Sub-Branch, from which he withdrew RMB 130,000 in cash to purchase a commercial apartment for his former wife, and transferred the remaining RMB 15,110,000 into the account of Chongqing Keyuan High-Tech Development Company at the Daping Sub-Branch of the Bank of Communications (hereinafter referred to as the Keyuan Company account) under his control. Thereafter, he transferred RMB 8,000,000 of this amount into his Shenyin Wanguo stock account for stock trading to make profits.

In December 2000, the defendant Chen Xin, fearing that his crimes would be exposed, prepared to flee. On December 15, he transferred RMB 3,000,000 from the Keyuan Company account to his Pacific Card; on December 28, he transferred RMB 3,000,000 from his Shenyin Wanguo stock account to the Keyuan Company account. Thereafter, he successively withdrew RMB 1,998,000 in cash from his Pacific Card and RMB 1,500,000 in cash from the Keyuan Company account, and also drew two bank drafts totaling RMB 4,000,000 from the Keyuan Company account, with a one-month presentation period. On January 2, 2001, upon learning that the Yangjiaping Sub-Branch had discovered the shortfall of RMB 40,000,000 in Account 921 and had begun an investigation, Chen Xin took cash of RMB 2,798,000, a bank deposit book of RMB 200,000, bank drafts of RMB 4,000,000, and his Pacific Card, and fled to Chengdu, where he rented a place to hide. He later secretly returned to Chongqing to retrieve all his stock trading credentials and the account credentials of the various companies under his control. On February 22, 2001, Chen Xin mailed the RMB 4,000,000 bank drafts, which had already passed the presentation period, to the Anti-Corruption Bureau of the Jiulongpo District People's Procuratorate of Chongqing. On March 10, 2001, public security authorities arrested Chen Xin at the Shenlang Internet Cafe in Chengdu. After the case was uncovered, the remaining stolen money and a large number of stocks were recovered, with a total value of RMB 35,182,871.1, while RMB 4,817,128.9 could not be recovered.

The above facts are confirmed by documentary evidence such as transfer checks, cash checks, telegraphic transfer vouchers, bank drafts, stock account credit advices, withdrawal vouchers, stock trading vouchers, the account of the public security authorities on the arrest of Chen Xin, and witness testimony. The defendant Chen Xin also confessed, and the facts are sufficient for determination.

This Court holds that the defendant Chen Xin, as a state-owned bank employee, taking advantage of his position, by means of withholding customer credit advices and substituting them with self-made false credit advices, on multiple occasions misappropriated customer funds totaling RMB 8,430,000 for stock trading to make profits and later repaid them, constituting the crime of misappropriation of public funds. By means of falsely increasing funds in the accounts and making false documents, he misappropriated RMB 40,000,000 of public funds into accounts under his control, using them to fill the shortfall of misappropriated funds, personal consumption, and stock trading to make profits. When his crimes were about to be exposed, he absconded with cash, bank drafts, and other items totaling over RMB 6,990,000, taking away all stock trading procedures and the bank account credentials of the companies under his control, placing the public funds not yet taken away under his own control, and refused to return them despite having the ability to do so, evincing the subjective intent of illegal possession. His conduct constituted the crime of embezzlement. The amount of embezzlement is exceptionally huge, and after the case was uncovered, over RMB 4,810,000 could not be recovered, making the circumstances of the crime particularly serious, and he should be punished according to law. The amount of misappropriated public funds is huge, and the circumstances are serious, also warranting punishment according to law. The facts found in the judgment of first instance and the ruling of second instance are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, the conviction is accurate, and the sentencing is appropriate. The trial procedures were lawful. In accordance with Article 285, Item (1) of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and the relevant provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the ruling is as follows:

Approve the criminal ruling of the Chongqing High People's Court (2001) Yu Gao Fa Xing Zhong Zi No. 432, which affirmed the judgment of first instance sentencing the defendant Chen Xin to death for the crime of embezzlement, with deprivation of political rights for life and confiscation of all personal property; sentencing him to fixed-term imprisonment of ten years for the crime of misappropriation of public funds; and deciding the combined sentence of death, with deprivation of political rights for life and confiscation of all personal property.

This ruling shall become legally effective upon service.

Presiding Judge: Gao Guijun

Judge: Zhang Xianxu

Acting Judge: Xu Jing

January 7, 2003

Clerk: Han Jinping

[Profile of the Presiding Judge]

Gao Guijun, Senior Judge, born in 1955, Master of Laws. Appointed as Deputy Chief Judge of the Trial Supervision Division of the Supreme People's Court in 2002.
